mappings.source: java.lang.M3StringAtom.getBytes with Latin-1 storage and a UTF-16 destination: Unsafe.getByte + StringUTF16.putChar per unit (A11 bulk only for same-coder copies, carried to A21 0aed554123)
mappings.target: for 64 units and up the bytes come out in bulk through a 4 KiB window (Unsafe.copyMemory) and StringLatin1.inflate widens them; the per-unit loop stays for shorter copies and for UTF-16 storage into a Latin-1 destination

mappings.source: java.lang.AbstractStringBuilder.inflateIfNeededFor(String) with an M3 argument: storage.facts().latin1 (the full facts computed on first use of every appended owner); appendChars(String, off, end) for a Latin-1 M3 String into a UTF-16 builder: StringUTF16.putCharsSB charAt loop (jdk-21+35 / A11, carried to 0aed554123)
mappings.target: inflateIfNeededFor answers from the owner's coder for a narrow owner and, for a wide owner, from prepared facts or M3String.contentIsLatin1 (a bulk scan in 1024-unit windows stopping at the first wide unit); appendChars hands a Latin-1 M3 range to the bulk cross-coder getBytes
